column1: # The route to v0.6.0 (the owner, 15 Nov 2026: one stable release, fresh install only, a closed list; v060/OWNER_PLAN_2026-11-15.md
# and v060/RULINGS.md). Kept by the orchestrator; the heartbeat's default view reads it. The items are built in parallel
# on main; the five stages follow, one at a time. Scope before date: the date is the earliest the whole list allows.

# (lane:step in progress.tsv whose status gives this step's state; "-" for the orchestrator's own or the owner's).

The owner enters the Gemini key on the rebuilt demo; then the Gemini checks (engine choice, one answer, budget, egress). From here the demo is protected

ospreyflow.app, the standard-look demo (Part 3): offline work done; the server proof, install and cutover after the GOV.UK rebuild; needs the owner's O1-O8 (DNS, Porkbun key, lease, window)
